cards.headline:
Divorce registered.
Court says: still married.
foot: One witness never asked the husband if he really wanted out.
Talking only to the wife wasn't enough.

cards.speaker: Wife → a friend
cards.headline: Can you sign as a witness here?
foot: Just the wife and the friend. The husband wasn't there.

cards.headline:
I don't have
her husband's number.

facts: Never met the husband before or after signing
Never asked him if he wanted a divorce

foot: The court didn't count the friend as a witness.

cards.headline:
A witness must see or hear
both spouses want out.
foot:
Hearing it secondhand doesn't count,
even from one of the spouses.

cards.tag: This case under Civil Code Art. 1050
cards.headline:
Three requirements.
The middle one wasn't met.

labels.result: Without the friend, one witness at most.

foot: Registered or not, the divorce was void (Art. 73).
